Frequently Asked Questions
What is AI Hair Studio?

AI Hair Studio is an all-in-one virtual makeover platform. It combines an AI Face Shape Detector (to analyze your facial features) with a powerful Hairstyle Simulator. Simply upload a photo to discover your face shape and try on 100+ hairstyles, colors, and cuts instantly—no app download required.

Is this AI hairstyle changer free?

Yes! AI Hair Studio offers a free trial for all new users. You can perform face shape analysis and try on selected hairstyles for free. We also offer premium plans for high-definition generation.

How do I find the best haircut for my face shape?

Simply use our "Analyze Face Shape" feature. Upload a front-facing photo, and our AI will detect your face shape (Round, Square, Oval, etc.) and recommend hairstyles.

Can I try on hair colors online?

Absolutely. Switch to the "Hair Color" mode to simulate Platinum Blonde, Red, or Dip Dye styles on your own photo.

✂️ Zero Risk, High Reward: Experiment with drastic cuts, bold colors, or bangs without touching a single hair on your head. Save money and avoid salon regrets.
🤖 AI-Powered Precision: Unlike old-school "sticker" apps, our generative AI analyzes your face shape to create realistic, blended results that actually look like you.
